title: The Street Named After a Light Bulb 💡 #history #tehran #shorts
description:
Over 120 years ago, a Tehran merchant bought a power generator instead of gardens. The street it lit became 'Cheragh Bargh' (Electric Light Street), today's Amir Kabir Street.
Does your street have a story? Comment below!
